steps.note: Provide the required event title before publishing.
Commit the requested Start now, 30-minute schedule.
Invite both named vendors required to submit bids.
Publish the auction event.
Verify that publishing produced a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid of 100.
Verify Vendor A's initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid of 85.
Verify Vendor A's revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window before evaluating and awarding.
Open the comparison grid containing both bidding vendors.
Verify that the lowest auction amount ranks first, making Vendor A the rank-1 bidder at 85.
Verify Vendor A's total is 10 units multiplied by the revised bid of 85.
Allocate all PR line items to Vendor A and submit the award proposal.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for Vendor A at the lowest evaluated bid.

steps.note: Approve the award with the required remark.
Complete the approved award and create the purchase order.
Verify the PO contains the awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the final event location.
Open the History tab where the completed event should appear.
